Metadata.description: Joel's portfolio: freelance web developer building websites, automations and custom bots with Next.js for businesses across Latin America.

About.title: About me
About.p1: I'm an Software Engineering student and Full Stack developer with experience building custom web applications and digital solutions tailored to each client's needs.
About.p2: I focus on building solid, scalable and maintainable web products, choosing the technologies and tools best suited to each project.
About.p3: I'm also constantly learning through my own projects, exploring new technologies, design patterns and software architectures to broaden my knowledge, keep improving my development practices and strengthen my professional profile.

cta.text: I'm open to new professional opportunities and challenges that let me contribute my technical skills, gain new experience and keep growing in the world of software development.

Contact.title: Contact
Contact.heading: Let's connect
Contact.intro: Looking to build a website or take an idea to the next level? I'm available to talk about your project and find the right solution.
